def: to hang up, i.e. weigh, or (figuratively) contemn

words.word: it neither shall it be valued

occurrences.text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
words: it neither shall it be valued

occurrences.text: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
